name: infrastructure
description: Substrate infrastructure — device health, doorway health, observation-layer heartbeats, and derived attestations.

attestation:device-health.description: Derived device-health attestation from observation-layer heartbeat data. Replaces HealthAttestation entry type. Raw heartbeats stay on the observation layer per spec §6.4.

attestation:doorway-health-summary.description: Periodic doorway health summary. Replaces DoorwayHeartbeatSummary entry type. Raw DoorwayHeartbeat entries remain operational on the observation layer.
